However, the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, as the evidence does not provide direct evidence of the molecular mechanisms or the role of the glucagon receptor in the pathway. The presence of multiple compounds targeting the same intermediate (glucagon receptor) supports the idea of a broader biological context, but further experimental validation is needed to establish the full causal relationship.
